line_text: Look! Over there! Are those...cactoids?

line_text: I don't like the look of this one bit. Seems like they're holding 'em hostage. But what would cactoids want with hostages?

line_text: I don't believe it!

speaker: Cartographers' Guild; Tchigri; Ruksel; Villager; Desert Wayfarer; Torrie
line_text: The cactoids all up and left! Now's our chance to go help my dad!

speaker: Cartographers' Guild; Tchigri; Ruksel; Villager; Desert Wayfarer; Torrie
line_text: I'm so glad you're all right! We didn't know what'd happened to you.

line_text: The others said it was too dangerous, but I knew I could handle it. But what about the cactoids? They ran off for good...right?

line_text: Whoa, what's that!?

speaker: Cartographers' Guild; Tchigri; Ruksel; Villager; Desert Wayfarer; Torrie
line_text: Hey, prickle-pants! Who do you think you are, kidnapping my dad!?

speaker: Cartographers' Guild; Tchigri; Ruksel; Villager; Desert Wayfarer; Torrie
line_text: Hey, prickle-pants! Who do you think you are, kidnapping my dad!?

speaker: Cartographers' Guild; Tchigri; Ruksel; Villager; Desert Wayfarer; Torrie
line_text: Find their son? You mean...they're related?

speaker: Cartographers' Guild; Tchigri; Ruksel; Villager; Desert Wayfarer; Torrie
line_text: So there's a bounty on this Dran, huh? You have any idea where he might be?

speaker: Cartographers' Guild; Tchigri; Ruksel; Villager; Desert Wayfarer; Torrie
line_text: So that's why you set the boat adrift—keep 'em from making the crossing!

speaker: Cartographers' Guild; Tchigri; Ruksel; Villager; Desert Wayfarer; Torrie
line_text: Right! Just leave it to us! Let's get going!

speaker: Cartographers' Guild; Tchigri; Ruksel; Villager; Desert Wayfarer; Torrie
line_text: Well, what're we waiting for!? Let's get him back to his family!

speaker: Cartographers' Guild; Tchigri; Ruksel; Villager; Desert Wayfarer; Torrie
line_text: Hey, we found your son for you! Now let my dad go!

speaker: Cartographers' Guild; Tchigri; Ruksel; Villager; Desert Wayfarer; Torrie
line_text: Hmm, I dunno. You think they're buying it?

speaker: Cartographers' Guild; Tchigri; Ruksel; Villager; Desert Wayfarer; Torrie
line_text: Look at 'em go! Guess they're gonna take him in after all!

speaker: Cartographers' Guild; Tchigri; Ruksel; Villager; Desert Wayfarer; Torrie
line_text: Look at 'em go. Heh. Guess their eyes aren't so good.

speaker: Cartographers' Guild; Tchigri; Ruksel; Villager; Desert Wayfarer; Torrie
line_text: You have to find that Dran! We'll keep the other cactoids here busy till you do. There must be some sign of him on the south bank.

speaker: Cartographers' Guild; Tchigri; Ruksel; Villager; Desert Wayfarer; Torrie
line_text: Well, if it isn't Sassan! Run away from Giza again, have you? Terra must be worried sick!

speaker: Cartographers' Guild; Tchigri; Ruksel; Villager; Desert Wayfarer; Torrie
line_text: I'm glad you came all this way to see me, but think of your poor friends back in Giza. It's not fair to them. Think how Terra must feel. You know you're the only cockatrice for me, Sassan. Now be a good boy and head back home to Giza, all right?

line_text: You know you're my favorite, Sassan.

speaker: Cartographers' Guild; Tchigri; Ruksel; Villager; Desert Wayfarer; Torrie
line_text: All right, Sassan. Off to Giza with you now. Give my best to Terra and Dania!
